zh.title: 參數化查詢：讓資料保持為資料
zh.summary: SQL 注入發生在不可信輸入改變了查詢語法的邊界。固定查詢結構並綁定值，能把使用者文字留在資料的位置。
objectives: 解釋字串拼接與參數綁定的差別。
在記憶體 SQLite 範例驗證含引號的名稱。

sections.heading: 查詢語法與輸入值要分開
paragraphs: 把輸入直接接進 SQL 字串，會讓資料中的引號或其他語法影響查詢解讀。參數化查詢先定義結構，再用資料庫介面的綁定機制傳入值；請依實際驅動程式的 placeholder 語法使用。
參數通常用於值，不能任意拿來代替資料表名、欄位名或排序方向。這些結構若真的需要動態變動，應從明確允許的固定選項映射，而不是直接接受任意字串。

sections.heading: 參數化之外仍有其他邊界
paragraphs: 參數綁定不會替你判斷使用者是否有權看那筆資料，也不會自動選擇資料庫帳號權限。授權、最小權限與錯誤處理仍需各自設計。
本練習用 SQLite 記憶體資料庫與一筆虛構名稱，觀察一般含引號文字如何被正確處理。它驗證這條查詢的值綁定，不代表所有程式路徑都安全。

example.title: 例子：查詢 O’Neil 這個名字
example.scenario: 用字串拼接時，一個正常姓名中的 ASCII 單引號也可能破壞 SQL 結構。下方程式用 ? 綁定值。
example.reasoning: SQL 結構維持 name = ?；姓名由 execute 的第二個參數傳入。資料庫會把整個姓名當成值來比對。
example.conclusion: 預期取得唯一一筆合成資料，不需要手動移除引號。

lab.title: 離線練習：記憶體資料庫查詢
lab.environment: 本機 Python 3 與 sqlite3 標準模組；不建立磁碟資料庫、不連線，也不使用真實個資。
steps: 閱讀下方程式，找出固定 SQL 與綁定值的位置。
把查詢值改成不存在的名稱，預期空清單。
lab.expected: 第一次輸出 [("O'Neil",)]；查詢不存在名稱時輸出 []。
lab.check: 如果改用參數作資料表名稱，為什麼不是同一種綁定問題？
lab.cleanup: 程式結束即關閉記憶體資料庫，不留下資料檔。
lab.code:
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
try:
    con.execute("CREATE TABLE people (name TEXT)")
    con.execute("INSERT INTO people VALUES (?)", ("O'Neil",))
    print(con.execute("SELECT name FROM people WHERE name = ?", ("O'Neil",)).fetchall())
finally:
    con.close()

en.title: Parameterized queries: keep data as data
en.summary: SQL injection crosses the boundary where untrusted input changes query syntax. A fixed query structure with bound values keeps user text in the data position.
objectives: Explain the difference between string concatenation and parameter binding.
Verify a name containing an apostrophe using in-memory SQLite.

sections.heading: Separate query syntax from input values
paragraphs: Concatenating input into SQL lets quotation marks and other syntax in the data affect parsing. A parameterized query defines the structure first, then passes values through the database interface’s binding mechanism. Use the placeholder syntax supported by the actual driver.

Parameters generally represent values, not arbitrary table names, column names or sort directions. If structure must vary, map from explicitly allowed fixed choices instead of accepting arbitrary strings.

sections.heading: Other boundaries remain after parameterization
paragraphs: Binding parameters does not determine whether a user may view a row or choose the database account’s privileges. Authorization, least privilege and error handling remain separate responsibilities.

The exercise uses an in-memory SQLite database and one fictional name to observe correct handling of ordinary text containing an apostrophe. It verifies value binding in this query, not every path in an application.

example.title: Example: looking up O’Neil
example.scenario: With string concatenation, an ordinary ASCII apostrophe in a name can disrupt SQL structure. The program below binds the value using ?.
example.reasoning: The SQL structure stays name = ?. The name is passed as the second argument to execute, so the database compares the entire name as a value.
example.conclusion: Expect exactly one synthetic row without manually removing apostrophes.

lab.title: Offline exercise: query an in-memory database
lab.environment: Use local Python 3 with its sqlite3 module. No disk database, networking or real personal data is used.
steps: Read the program and locate fixed SQL and bound values.
Run it locally and check the output.
Change the lookup value to an absent name and expect an empty list.
lab.expected: The first output is [("O'Neil",)]; an absent name produces [].
lab.check: Why is substituting a table name a different problem from binding a value?
lab.cleanup: The in-memory database closes when the program ends and leaves no data file.
lab.code:
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
try:
    con.execute("CREATE TABLE people (name TEXT)")
    con.execute("INSERT INTO people VALUES (?)", ("O'Neil",))
    print(con.execute("SELECT name FROM people WHERE name = ?", ("O'Neil",)).fetchall())
finally:
    con.close()

zh.prompt: 參數綁定的主要目的為何？
options: 讓所有使用者取得管理權
讓輸入值與查詢語法分開
rationales: 固定結構與綁定值維持語法邊界。

en.prompt: What is the main purpose of parameter binding?
options: Separate input values from query syntax
rationales: This is not the purpose of parameters.
Fixed structure and bound values preserve the syntax boundary.

zh.prompt: 使用者要選排序欄位，較適當作法是？
options: 從允許的選項映射到固定欄位名
假設值 placeholder 可代表任何 SQL 語法
rationales: 任意結構輸入會重新跨越邊界。
映射限定可形成的查詢結構。
值與識別碼不是可任意互換的類型。

en.prompt: A user selects a sort column. What is appropriate?
options: Map allowed options to fixed column names
Assume a value placeholder can represent any SQL syntax
rationales: Arbitrary structural input crosses the boundary again.
Mapping constrains the possible query structure.
Values and identifiers are not interchangeable.
